verdict.rationale: Adyen Agentic is an agentic payments product, so HTTP 402 per-call machine payments is a fair axis. The evidence only covers shopper-oriented ACP/UCP checkout flows, credential tokenization and product-feed sync for merchant catalogs. Nothing in the pack mentions HTTP 402, per-call metering, or monetizing an API without a checkout session; the checkout-session tokens are an adjacent capability, not this one.

support.subject: As a developer, I can monetize an API or service with HTTP 402 machine payments that agents pay per call without a checkout UI
